'''First Observer''' was a position within the court of [[Preedu III]], [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] of [[Tamban]], many hundreds of [[Standard year/Legends|years]] prior to the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The individual who held the post named the [[Koornacht Cluster/Legends|Koornacht Cluster]].<ref name="CTD">''[[Cracken's Threat Dossier]]''</ref>
